findings.title: Reference identity comparison is not atomically bound to helper snapshot or action
evidence: 技研/E4_旧引用等待副作用长输入_20261103.md:28
技研/实验/E4_旧引用与等待副作用与长输入/ax-identity.mjs:17-40
findings.detail: Two separate races remain. First: helper completes snapshot with old element A, page swaps same-name B before host AX read, then the host records B backend as if it belonged to old ref. Second: host pre-action AX comparison passes A, page swaps B before helper semantically re-resolves role/name/nth, then helper clicks B. E4b has no helper and only proves backendID changes under serial replacement; it does not prove either handoff. Requirement promises replacement never clicked, whereas stated protocol can permit it.
findings.verificationBoundary: Static timing/interleaving proof from documented sequence; no native/UI rerun and no claim that production implementation exists.
findings.recommendation: Add two deterministic S1 latch red tests (snapshot→AX binding and comparison→helper action). Obtain element identity from the same snapshot resolution and execute against already bound node identity, or otherwise prove atomic equivalent; repeated preflight semantic lookup alone is insufficient.

findings.title: Chunk-completion progress cannot equal actual page characters during interrupted chunk
evidence: 技研/实验/E4_旧引用与等待副作用与长输入/run.mjs:78-85
findings.detail: Design persists count only after each 2000-character chunk finishes, yet T060 requires exact agreement with actual page length on mid-command interruption. Example: chunk1 confirmed2000; chunk2 types333 then helper dies. Receipt confirmed2000 while page2333. No readback or unknown-tail representation is defined. E4 tests unchunked4096/16384/65536 and does not test proposed2000 chunk recovery.
findings.verificationBoundary: Contract inconsistency and illustrative schedule, not an executed product failure.
findings.recommendation: Separate confirmedChars/unknownTail from observedChars. Only claim exact observed progress after reliable target readback; otherwise return bounded uncertainty and prohibit full resend. Place fault latch inside a chunk rather than at its completion boundary.

findings.title: Some new S1 mandatory checks still have no concrete case criteria
findings.detail: S1 now mandates cross-site OOPIF and helper-killed automatic reconnection. The case document has no explicit OOPIF/cross-site/automatic-reconnect case wording; T053 still says ordinary same/cross-origin fixtures and E3 already proved it, and T059 only resets after three timeouts. T107 properly adds already-connected park→reattach and effect counters, so do not reopen that fix.
findings.recommendation: Add OOPIF child-target/process prerequisite and per-frame readback to T053, plus helper death→same page reconnect outcome/timeout/no duplicates to existing lifecycle cases; link them from S1.

findings.title: Cross-page stale-ref rejection cannot distinguish identical native reference strings
findings.detail: Each page has an independent helper/ref map, while external arguments carry only --page B and @e4. If A and B snapshots each emit @e4, misusing A reference on B and legitimately using B reference produce byte-identical requests. Per-page backendID maps select B in both cases; server cannot infer which snapshot supplied the string. T051 specifically requires A ref plus pageB to be stale, which the protocol cannot guarantee.
findings.recommendation: Return host-unique public references containing page/snapshot generation or globally assigned IDs, bind them to underlying helper ref plus backend identity, validate provenance, and translate only after validation. Add colliding-ref A/B negative and positive controls.
findings.verificationBoundary: Contract counterexample, not an actual native/UI replay.
